messages:
Anya Ramirez: hi team! i'm Anya — joining as a runtime engineer on the inference backend. started today, excited to dig in :wave: quick q: i got my macbook but vpn isn't connecting (okta mfa times out). also can't assume the aws-redwood-dev role. who's best to ping for laptop + aws access? also where's the canonical onboarding checklist? thanks!

Tyler Hu: hey Anya, welcome! :tada: ping @kevin for IT/VPN. onboarding checklist is here: https://wiki.redwood.dev/onboarding/new-hire-checklist — it has the github/aws/okta steps. i'll DM you to confirm what perms you need.

Kevin Ortiz: hey Anya — IT. sorry about the friction. can you run `sudo /usr/local/bin/vpn_connect --log` and paste the output? also what macOS version are you on? if you'd like we can remote in.

Anya Ramirez: macOS 13.4.1. here's the error i get (redacted): ```ERROR: Okta authentication timed out after 30s``` tried re-enrolling MFA twice.

Zara Kim: welcome Anya! i'm zara on infra-ops — we manage the aws roles. @kevin i'll let you add her, but if you can share your employee id i'll add `arn:aws:iam::123456:role/redwood-dev` until onboarding is done.

Tyler Hu: also you'll need github team access for runtime. @devex team — can you invite Anya to `redwood/runtime` and `redwood/internal`?

Devex Team: welcome Anya! sent the GitHub invites and added you to the slack groups. for local dev follow the README: `git clone git@github.com:redwood/runtime.git && make dev`. if you hit docker permission errors try `sudo chown $USER:docker /var/run/docker.sock` or `chmod g+rw /var/run/docker.sock`.

IT Bot: Automated message: VPN ticket #IT-9872 created for Anya Ramirez. ETA 2 hours.

Anya Ramirez: thanks all — really appreciate the quick help. small culture q: do teams still do an IRL lunch for new hires or is that people-ops? :salad:

Zara Kim: we try to do a team lunch during week 1 if schedules allow. i'll coordinate with people-ops and send a poll for Friday. fun fact: i used to compete in salsa dancing :dancer:

Kevin Ortiz: fun fact: my first job was fixing dial-up modems in college :old_keypad:

Tyler Hu: welcome again! short intro huddle tomorrow 10:00am PST — calendar invite sent. feel free to drop follow-ups here or DM me. :)
